summary: Equus Total Return, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce its net asset value for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release reporting net assets of $20.9 million, or $1.50 per share, up from $1.19 per share at year-end 2025. Changes were driven by a $5.0 million increase in the fair value of Morgan E P, Inc. due to higher crude oil prices, partially offset by a $0.5 million decrease in CitroTech holdings. No special situation event is present; this is a routine quarterly NAV update for a closed-end fund.
